name: Dhanvantri Jeevan Rekha Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1993, Dhanvantri Jeevan Rekha
Ltd provides Medical and Health-care Services.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
DJRL runs an NABH-accredited hospital by the name of Dhanvantri Hospital and provides a varied range of patient care and super specialty services, and other diagnostic services in Meerut. It offers specialized therapy & support, diagnosis & investigation, and medical treatment & surgery.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.99 times its book value
Debtor days have improved from 36.9 to 29.0 days.
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 4.46% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 1.61% over last 3 years.
